وَدُودٌ : see وِدٌّ. ―
-b2- الوَدُودُ, as an epithet applied to God, The loving towards his servants, (IAmb, L,) or, towards those who obey: (Beyd, lxxxv. 14:) or He who regards with approbation his righteous servants: or He who is beloved in the hearts of his saints. (IAth, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
